result:
Build succeeds cleanly with 0 warnings/0 errors, and the calor checker confirmed compile, contract, effect, and reference integrity all pass.

I implemented the three new operations in `FolderSync.calr`, following the existing conventions (private helper functions like `EntryName`/`FormatEntry`, `fs:rw` effects, in-place upsert semantics via the existing `WriteIndexEntry`/`RemoveIndexEntry`):

- **`RecordDelete`** — reads the existing tombstone stamp via `IndexStamp` (`-1` if absent); leaves the file untouched when `existing >= stamp`, otherwise upserts.
- **`SyncTwoWay`** — processes every source name in source file order, then every target-only name in target order. A private helper `TwoWayApply` computes `s`, `t`, `d`, `m = max(s,t)` per name and applies the policy: `d >= m` deletes from each index where present (counting each removal), else newer-wins upserts into target (`s>t`) or source (`t>s`), else no-op. The target-only set is determined correctly "as of start" because source-loop writes only ever touch source names, so a target-only name can never become source-present before it's processed.
- **`SyncWithPolicy`** — delegates to `SyncTwoWay` when `twoWay` is true, otherwise to the existing `Sync` (tombstone ignored).

All existing functions are unchanged, so their observable behavior is preserved. The spec is fully satisfied.
